verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 documents webhooks that fire on process events, sandbox lifecycle changes, and file modifications. It also documents a configurable auto_resume behavior where inbound access automatically wakes a paused sandbox. Both are first-party, event-driven automatic actions, but the webhooks only notify an external consumer, which must then perform the action. There is no evidence of a user-defined rule engine that maps conditions to in-product actions. Missing for 10: user-definable event→action rules or conditions, event filtering, in-product action execution beyond callbacks, detailed webhook configuration docs, independent corroboration.
